concepts.def: Evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, runoff, infiltration, groundwater flow.
Permeable rock storing groundwater; recharged by infiltration; over-abstraction lowers water table.
Highest catch that can be removed indefinitely; theoretically half of carrying capacity (Schaefer 1954).
Nutrient enrichment causes algal blooms, decomposition, hypoxia; collapse of aquatic ecosystem.
Farmed fish/shellfish; ~50% of fish consumed (FAO 2020); concerns about effluent and disease.
Newfoundland Grand Banks cod fishery collapsed 1992; moratorium imposed; lesson in overfishing.
